functions.description: Parse base syslog-style header (timestamp, host, pid) and isolate the trailing KVP payload into a scratch field
Extract key=value pairs (including quoted values) from the scratch KVP payload
Normalize severity/protocol casing, rename msg to message, derive IP version, and clean up scratch fields
Derive traffic direction based on RFC1918 private address ranges for src_ip
Classify high-level event category based on event_id prefix for downstream mapping

add.name: event_category
add.value: event_id && event_id.startsWith('AUTH') ? 'authentication' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('VPN') ? 'vpn' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('HC') ? 'host_checker' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('SYS') ? 'system' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('CERT') ? 'certificate' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('ADMIN') ? 'administration' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('SEC') ? 'security' : event_id && event_id.startsWith('SESSION') ? 'session' : 'other'
